Definition: probably from G5343; fugitive; Phygellus, an apostate Christian:--Phygellus.
BiblicalUsage: Phygellus is named once, in 2 Timothy 1:15, among all those in Asia who turned away from Paul in his imprisonment — Phygellus and Hermogenes. Paul does not say what drove them off, only that they left when standing with him cost something.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that desertion in hard times is its own testimony. His life is told on his People profile.
